text.4:58: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye restore deposits to their owners, and, if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly. Lo! comely is this which Allah admonisheth you. Lo! Allah is ever Hearer, Seer.
text.8:27: O ye who believe! Betray not Allah and His messenger, nor knowingly betray your trusts.
text.23:8: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
text.70:32: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
